title: Electrical product testing
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Understand why the test was failed (re-evaluate).
3. Ensure appropriate warnings and notices are placed on the equipment (as applicable).
4. State the maximum duration the appliance can remain in service before repair.

A test record is the written record of the tests that have been carried out by the electrical safety tester. This is usually signed and witnessed by the plant inspector or responsible manager.<|endoftext|>
